workspacePendingPage.heading: Your workspace isn't ready yet
workspacePendingPage.description: This can happen while a workspace is being set up, or if something went wrong along the way. Try refreshing in a few minutes, or contact whoever invited you if it keeps happening.

dashboardTenantPicker.heading: Choose a workspace
dashboardTenantPicker.description: You have access to more than one workspace. Pick one to continue.

tenantsView.title: Tenants
tenantsView.description: Every site on the platform, read from the real tenants table.

emailAlertsBanner.title: Email alerts not configured
emailAlertsBanner.description: RESEND_API_KEY isn't set, so operators won't be emailed when a tenant needs attention — check this page manually.

findingsView.title: Findings
findingsView.description: Operational conditions detected by scheduled sweeps, across every tenant.

findingsCard.title: Open findings
findingsCard.empty: No open findings for this tenant — everything's healthy.

ownerHomePage.description: Your site at a glance. Everything here is live.
ownerHomePage.readOnlyHint: Need one of these changed? Ask your platform contact — these values are wired into your site's hosting.

provisioningBanner.runningDescription: This page updates on its own.
provisioningBanner.failedDescriptionFallback: This step failed — view the steps to retry.

ownerElevationDescription.STALLED: The owner hasn't accepted their invite yet — nothing failed, but they can't edit their own content until they do.
ownerElevationDescription.AMBIGUOUS_MEMBERSHIP: More than one membership matches this tenant's owner — resolve it manually in Sanity Manage.

tenantDomainPage.subCopy: The one piece of setup that is genuinely yours to finish.
tenantDomainPage.bodyCopy: Add these records at your DNS provider. Verification usually completes within an hour.
tenantDomainPage.verifiedEmptyState: This domain is verified — there's nothing left to configure.
tenantDomainPage.unavailableState: DNS records aren't available right now.

lookForm.heading: Look
lookForm.subtitle: Theme this site. Everything previews instantly below — nothing is live until you save.
lookForm.alertError: Couldn't save Look settings — try again.
lookForm.presetDescription: The starting point nearly every tenant picks. Sets fonts, radius, density, chrome, and voice defaults.
lookForm.accentHueDescription: Only the hue changes — lightness & chroma are fixed (OKLCH), so contrast stays WCAG-verified.
lookForm.logoHueDescription: Tints the wordmark's tonal steps (--logo-1/2/3). Follows the accent hue unless you set it.
lookForm.brandImagesDescription: Stored in Vercel Blob — no on-the-fly transforms, so what you upload is what ships.
lookForm.logoFieldHint: PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG · falls back to the polygon wordmark
lookForm.faviconFieldHint: Pre-cropped square, please — Blob can't crop it for you (an SVG's viewBox counts as its shape). Non-square uploads are rejected.
lookForm.terminalChromeDescription: Window frame + terminal prompt around the site — the single most defining console-vs-editorial switch. Defaults from your preset. Not saved yet — site_config has no column for this field.
lookForm.headingFontDescription: Closed set of five (static next/font loaders). Each renders in its own face.
lookForm.footerNote: Radius scale and density are saved with the rest of this form but don't yet drive the inline preview above.

lookPreview.samplePara: A short dispatch to show heading and body type, accent, logo tones, and radius together.
lookPreview.previewNote: Unsaved form state → CSS custom properties, matching production's OKLCH ramp. Nothing here is live until you save.
lookPreview.fullPagePreviewDescription: Reserved — needs a save to reflect
lookPreview.framePlaceholder: Iframe of the real site in preview mode. Needs a save (or a preview-mode URL) to reflect — space and routing reserved now.

voiceSettings.heading: Voice
voiceSettings.description: The words the site puts in its own mouth. Your preset already sets sensible defaults.
voiceSettings.basicAlert: Nothing required here. Your preset determines the default voice. Most tenants never open the Advanced fields below.
voiceSettings.advancedOverrideInfo: Every field is an override. Leave one blank to inherit the preset's voice-pack value (shown as the placeholder). Clearing a field reverts to the preset default — it does not set the string to empty.

tenantDetailsForm.heading: Tenant details
tenantDetailsForm.description: The fast part. Everything after this runs automatically, each step resumable on failure.
tenantDetailsForm.domainHint: The public domain this tenant's site will answer to.
tenantDetailsForm.ownerEmailHint: The person who'll manage this tenant. An existing account gets access immediately; a new address gets an email invite to sign in.

provisioningStatusView.startErrorNotFound: Couldn't find this tenant — refresh the page and try again.
provisioningStatusView.startErrorArchived: This tenant is archived; provisioning can't be started.
provisioningStatusView.startNoticeAlreadyInProgress: A provisioning run is already in progress for this tenant — this page will update automatically once it finishes.
provisioningStatusView.pollErrorWarning: Couldn't refresh the latest status — retrying automatically.

permission.headline: Missing permission to complete this step
permission.body: The provisioning credentials aren't allowed to do what this step needs — often inviting a project member or granting access. It may need to be finished manually in the Sanity Manage or Vercel dashboard.
permission.nextStep: Grant the missing permission, then retry.

duplicate.headline: Already in use by another tenant
duplicate.body: Something this step is trying to create — a project handle, an email invite, or a domain — is already claimed elsewhere.

network.headline: Couldn't reach the provisioning service
network.body: The request to Sanity or Vercel timed out or the connection dropped before finishing. This is often temporary.

unknown.headline: This step failed
unknown.body: Provisioning hit an error that isn't recognized yet. The technical details below may help diagnose it.
unknown.nextStep: Retry, or check the technical details before asking for help.

provisioningStatusView.runStartedPending: Waiting for the run to start…

tenantDangerPage.title: Danger zone
tenantDangerPage.description: Irreversible actions for this tenant. Restricted to superadmins.

studioPage.title: Studio
studioPage.notProvisionedDescription: This tenant's Sanity project hasn't finished provisioning. Try again once provisioning completes.

tenantDetailsPanel.heading: Tenant details
tenantDetailsPanel.provisioningStartedError: This tenant's provisioning has already started; its details can no longer be edited.
tenantDetailsPanel.archivedError: This tenant is archived; its details can no longer be edited.
tenantDetailsPanel.ownerAlreadyJoinedError: This tenant's owner has already signed in, so their email can no longer be corrected here — this would transfer ownership instead.
tenantDetailsPanel.ownerEmailTakenError: This email already has a pending invite on this tenant.
tenantDetailsPanel.lockedAnnouncement: Some tenant detail fields are now locked.
tenantDetailsPanel.unlockedAnnouncement: More tenant detail fields are now editable.
tenantDetailsPanel.fieldLockedReasonStep: Locked — the "{step}" step has already completed and used this value.

archivedTenantNotice.title: This tenant is archived
archivedTenantNotice.description: Deprovisioned {date}. Everything on these pages is read-only.

deprovisionTenantControl.description: Removes the tenant's custom domain, deletes its Studio project, and archives its Sanity project so it stops billing rather than deleting it. The tenant row itself is archived, not deleted. This cannot be undone.
deprovisionTenantControl.dialogDescription: This dispatches deprovision-tenant.yml, which tears down every provisioned resource for this tenant. Type the tenant's name to confirm.
deprovisionTenantControl.confirmHint: Must match the tenant's name exactly.
deprovisionTenantControl.dryRunLabel: Dry run (preview only, nothing is deleted)
deprovisionTenantControl.deleteDescription: Permanently removes this tenant and every dependent row (memberships, subscribers, bookmarks, domains, site config) from the database. This cannot be undone, and releases its domain for reuse.
deprovisionTenantControl.deleteDialogDescription: This permanently deletes the tenant row and everything that depends on it. Type the tenant's name to confirm.
deprovisionTenantControl.deleteConfirmHint: Must match the tenant's name exactly.

reactivateTenantControl.description: Brings an archived tenant back online by re-running provisioning: it un-archives the tenant row and its Sanity project, re-maps the custom domain, and recreates the revalidation webhook. Use this instead of deleting a tenant that was deprovisioned by mistake.
reactivateTenantControl.dialogDescription: This dispatches provision-tenant.yml, which restores every provisioned resource for this tenant. Type the tenant's name to confirm.
reactivateTenantControl.confirmHint: Must match the tenant's name exactly.

featuresSettings.heading: Features
featuresSettings.description: Turn tenant-facing capabilities on or off. Locked toggles require the Growth plan.

toggleDescription.COMMENTS: Let readers leave comments on posts.
toggleDescription.BOOKMARKS: Let readers save posts to read later.
toggleDescription.NEWSLETTER: Show the newsletter signup form on the site.
